description: About us The team behind CopyKat helps established businesses raise capital through a token offering, without giving up equity. We have been doing this since the 2017 ICO boom, with 200+ companies supported worldwide. Based in Singapore, working across APAC, the U.S. and Europe. CopyKat is our own software product: AI search visibility for SEO writers. It shows the prompts buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude, who gets cited today, and which pages to rewrite so your content gets cited instead. Writers and SEO teams make the change, re-run the check and watch the citation appear. CopyKat is built for independent writers, small SEO shops and in-house content teams, with a 14-day free trial and monthly paid plans. We are now taking CopyKat to market, and we are looking for the person who will own its growth. Role Overview CopyKat is looking for a Marketing Manager to own its user acquisition. This is a full-time, fully remote role, working Singapore business hours (9:00 to 18:00 SGT, UTC+8). This is not a role for someone who waits for a brief. You will work independently, decide where CopyKat's next users come from, and run the channels that bring them in: outbound outreach, inbound content and SEO, media and creator collaborations, paid ads, communities, partnerships, and whatever else works. You will test fast, measure everything, and double down on what converts. You will work closely with the founders and the product team, and you will be accountable for one thing above all: a steadily growing number of active and paying CopyKat users. Key Responsibilities • Own CopyKat's user acquisition strategy and plan, from first signup to paying customer. • Run outbound outreach to SEO writers, content agencies, SEO shops and in-house content teams: lead sourcing, email sequences, LinkedIn and X outreach, and follow-up. • Build inbound growth through content: blog articles, guides, comparison pages, case studies, newsletters and social posts that rank on Google and get cited by AI search. • Set up and manage media collaborations: guest articles, podcasts, newsletter features, reviews and mentions in SEO and content marketing publications. • Find and work with creators, KOLs and SEO influencers on YouTube, LinkedIn, X and other channels. • Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit or other platforms, within a clear budget and target cost per signup. • Build a presence in the communities where SEO writers and content marketers spend time, such as Reddit, Slack and Discord groups, forums and product directories. • Support launches, events and conferences, including invite-only betas and product announcements. • Drive activation and conversion together with the product team: onboarding emails, free-trial follow-up, and upgrade campaigns. • Set up and track funnel metrics, from traffic and signups to activation, trial-to-paid conversion and cost per acquisition, using tools such as GA4 and PostHog. • Run regular experiments on channels, messaging, landing pages and offers, and share what you learn. • Report weekly to management on results, spend, learnings and next steps. • Bring user feedback and market insights back to the product team to help shape the roadmap. What This Person Will Be Accountable For • Growing CopyKat's signups, active users and paying customers month after month. • Building repeatable acquisition channels, not one-off spikes. • Spending the marketing budget efficiently, with a clear view of cost per signup and per paying customer. • Keeping the funnel measured, visible and honest. • Representing CopyKat professionally to users, partners, media and creators. What Success Looks Like • A steady, measurable flow of new CopyKat signups from several channels. • Outreach, content, collaborations and ads that each have clear targets and known results. • Trial users turning into paying customers at a rate that keeps improving. • CopyKat becomes a known name among SEO writers and content teams. • Management always knows what is working, what is not, and what you are trying next. Requirements • Proven experience in growth, user acquisition or performance marketing, ideally for a SaaS or software product. • Hands-on experience with several acquisition channels: outbound outreach, content and SEO, paid ads, influencer or media collaborations. • Good understanding of SEO and content marketing, and an interest in how AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) is changing it. • Data-driven: comfortable setting up tracking, reading funnel data and making decisions from it. • Strong writer, able to create clear, convincing copy for emails, landing pages, ads and articles. • Self-managed: proactive, organized, and able to work independently without needing constant supervision. • Professional written and spoken English. • Available to work Singapore business hours (9:00 to 18:00 SGT, UTC+8), fully remote. Nice to Have • Experience marketing a product to SEO professionals, writers, agencies or marketing teams. • Experience launching or growing an early-stage product from zero to its first thousands of users. • An existing network of SEO creators, newsletters, podcasts or media contacts. • Experience with tools such as GA4, PostHog, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, email outreach tools, Ahrefs or Semrush. • Experience with product-led growth: free plans, trials, onboarding and upgrade flows. • Additional languages that support markets across APAC, the U.S. or Europe. Ideal Candidate Profile You are a hands-on growth marketer who likes owning a number and moving it. You know there is no single channel that does it all. You can write the outreach email, brief the creator, launch the ad and publish the article, and you know which of them is actually bringing in users. You do not wait to be told what to do. You plan your own week, run experiments, and report back with results and a clear next step. • Most importantly, you take ownership of results. You are self-managed, organized and curious, and excited to help CopyKat become the tool SEO writers rely on to get their content cited by AI search.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: This role will be based in Indonesia, with coverage across ASEAN. The Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) is the technical force multiplier of Elastic's partner ecosystem. Where an account Solutions Architect wins one deal at a time, you build the technical capacity of a focused portfolio of partners — system integrators, resellers, MSSPs and cloud providers — so they source pipeline, win deals and deliver Elastic without us in the room. The role rests on three pillars: drive growth with and through partners (partner-sourced pipeline); act as an architect of leverage (every partner engineer you certify adds technical selling capacity Elastic didn't have to hire); and co-innovate on repeatable solutions (joint blueprints, demos and partner-built offerings on our technology — including vertical and managed solutions Elastic doesn't build itself). Architect of leverage • Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders. • Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner — the technical section of the Joint Business Plan — and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders. • Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps — workshops, hands-on labs, accreditations, certifications — that move partners up a defined technical maturity model, from first knowledge to fully autonomous, market-leading practices. Co-innovate on repeatable solutions • Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, and distributors or MSPs. • Back partner-built solutions on Elastic — vertical, sovereign and managed offerings that extend our product surface beyond what Elastic builds itself. • Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts. What You Bring: • 5+ years in technology solutions, practice development, architecture or consulting in the following technological domain (Security, Observability, AI). • 2+ years of pre-sales experience will be prioritised but not required, ideally partner-facing: channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSSP ecosystems. • Professional fluency in English and another ASEAN language (Bahasa, Thai, Vietnamese) will be prioritised, as you'll be working directly with customers in ASEAN and collaborating with global teams. • Practitioners in the following domain looking to move to a customer-facing role are encouraged to apply: (Security Analysts, SRE, DevSecOps, Developers, Search & AI practitioners) • A one-to-many mindset: you would rather teach ten engineers to run the demo than run it ten times yourself, and you can show where your enablement turned into someone else's win. • Working knowledge of security operations (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) and/or observability (logging, tracing, infrastructure monitoring) — nice to have: an understanding of AI and semantic search technologies (RAG, vector search, NLP). • Professional experience architecting or operating solutions on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure. • Commercial fluency: you can read a deal, talk services scope and margin with a partner, and translate technical capability into the business case their customer buys. • Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences — a partner engineer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon, an executive sponsor in the evening. • Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter's bias to action; you inspire partner teams to work on what is most relevant, not just what is urgent. • Ability to travel up to 40%, as this role is based in Indonesia and requires coverage across the ASEAN region. title: Senior Data Scientist (Remote)
description: Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch. Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact. The Role We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build the credit models that decide who Cinch lends to, on what terms, and how we collect. Every subscription at Cinch is a customer relationship and a credit exposure on a physical device, so your models directly shape growth, losses and asset returns. You will own credit and risk models end to end: from data exploration and feature design through validation, deployment and monitoring. You will work with SQL and Python, partner with Data, Product and Engineering teams, and turn model outputs into decisions the business can act on. You are expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with Claude. We expect responsible AI use, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the author's own responsibility. Responsibilities Risk and credit modelling • Build, validate and maintain credit scoring models for new and repeat subscribers - A Score and B Score models. • Develop early-warning and delinquency models, and support collections strategy and prioritisation • Run experiments and champion/challenger tests to prove a model improves approval rates, losses or recovery before it scales • Track model performance over time (stability, drift, bias) and retrain when it degrades Data and features • Collect and blend data from multiple sources (applications, payments, devices, bureau and alternative data) into clean, documented feature sets • Work with data analysts and engineers on dimensional models and data pipelines so features stay consistent between training and production • Define and track the risk KPIs the business relies on (approval rate, default rate, loss per cohort, recovery rate) Decisioning and partnership • Turn model outputs into clear decision rules and recommendations to guide credit policy at Cinch. • Present findings and trade-offs to leadership in plain language, including what the model cannot tell us • Partner with Risk & Data leadership on credit policy and regulatory expectations in each market Standards, AI and mentoring • Document models so another data scientist can reproduce and audit them • Use AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code) to speed up exploration, coding and documentation, and set the standard for responsible use with sensitive customer data Qualifications Must-have • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field (or equivalent experience) • 6-9 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, including building models that went into production • Strong SQL and Python (including familiarity with all the relevant frameworks and packages such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or similar) for data manipulation and modelling • Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning for classification and risk: logistic regression, gradient boosting, calibration, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics such as AUC, KS and Gini • Experience with model validation, monitoring and documentation, and explaining model results to non-technical stakeholders • Working knowledge of dimensional modelling and data pipelines, and the ability to work with analysts and engineers on feature data • Working proficiency with AI tools Nice-to-haves • Experience in fintech, lending, consumer credit, e-commerce or subscription businesses • Credit scorecard development, collections analytics or fraud detection • Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools (for example BigQuery, dbt, SQLMesh) • Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset or Looker • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, and with deploying models to production • Familiarity with regulatory expectations for credit data and model use in Malaysia or other Southeast Asian markets

description:
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

Role Overview

The Senior Accountant – Indonesia owns the finance function for the Indonesia entity across both Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), operating with a good degree of independence and reporting to the Finance Manager. This role owns customer invoicing (Dynamics and Coretax e-Faktur) and customer receipt posting/settlement and plays a key role in preparing for and supporting the Indonesia entity's statutory audit, drawing on prior audit exposure (company-side or auditor-side). Over time, this role is expected to also provide part-time, dedicated support to Malaysia accounting, with time allocation adjusted based on business needs.

Responsibilities

Accounts Payable (Indonesia)

Own day-to-day AP operations for the Indonesia entity, including invoice verification, data entry, and payment processing.
Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, employee expense claims, and related payments in accordance with company policies.
Manage AP-related month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, and reconciliations, aligned with the group close timeline.
Monitor vendor aging reports and proactively resolve outstanding invoices and discrepancies.
Manage vendor onboarding, documentation, and query resolution.
Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for AP-related accounts, including Fixed Assets.

Accounts Receivable & Customer Invoicing (Indonesia)

Own end-to-end customer invoicing for the Indonesia entity, including issuance of Dynamics invoices and Coretax tax invoices (e-Faktur).
Post and settle customer receipts in Dynamics on a timely and accurate basis, ensuring correct application against open invoices.
Prepare AR aging reports, monitor outstanding customer balances with Finance Manager or Credit Collection team where needed.
Ensure invoicing and receipt records are properly documented and reconciled to support monthly close and reporting.

Tax, Compliance & Audit

Manage local tax reporting (VAT and withholding), maintaining accurate documentation and liaising directly with the external tax consultant.
Ensure compliance with local regulations, tax requirements, internal financial controls, and accounting standards.
Take primary responsibility for preparing supporting schedules and documentation for the statutory audit.

Regional Support (Malaysia)

Provide part-time, dedicated support to Malaysia accounting activities as a shared resource, with scope and time allocation to be defined based on business needs.

General

Work with internal stakeholders to ensure proper documentation, approvals, and coding of transactions.
Liaise with vendors, customers, and external parties on payment and invoice-related matters.
Perform other ad hoc finance and administrative tasks as assigned.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; Brevet Pajak or equivalent tax certification is an advantage.
Approximately 5–7 years of relevant accounting or finance experience, with solid exposure to both AP and AR.
Audit experience is required — either from the company side (preparing audit schedules, liaising directly with auditors) or the auditor side (public accounting firm).
Strong working knowledge of Indonesian tax and invoicing requirements, including e-Faktur/Coretax, VAT, and withholding tax.
Experience with ERP systems required; hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics strongly preferred.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with willingness to take on cross-border/shared-resource responsibilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including direct liaison with auditors and tax consultants; comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-cultural regional setup.
Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

description:

Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.

At Hach, a Veralto company, we ensure water quality for people around the world, and every team member plays a vital role in that mission. Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy-to-use solutions.

As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you'll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you'll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world's everyday water needs, and where you'll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.

Motivated by the highest possible stakes in climate change and global health, we're working together within a rapidly digitizing industry to find innovative technologies that guarantee the safety of our water and our environment. More about us: https://www.hach.com/about-us

We offer

Competitive compensation package
Flexible working arrangements
Professional onboarding and training opportunities
Career coaching and development programs
Collaborative and supportive international team environment
Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
Opportunities for growth within a global organization

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations & Incentive Compensation, the Variable Compensation Analyst is responsible for administering and optimizing Hach's variable compensation programs across the European sales organization. This role serves as the system owner and subject matter expert for commission operations, ensuring accurate and compliant incentive processing while driving continuous improvement through data analysis and system enhancements. The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Sales Enablement teams to deliver actionable insights, improve compensation processes, and support strategic business objectives.

This position is part of the Sales Operations organization and will be remote within APAC, with a strong preference for candidates based in Indonesia.

In this role, a typical day will look like

Administer the end-to-end variable compensation process, including commission calculations, payouts, adjustments, quota management, and case resolution.
Own and optimize the Oracle Fusion Incentive Compensation (FIC) platform, including system configuration, governance, enhancements, and long-term roadmap planning.
Serve as the primary subject matter expert for commission processing and incentive plan administration, providing guidance to stakeholders across the business.
Analyze commission-related inquiries and system performance data to identify trends, resolve root causes, and implement process improvements.
Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to evaluate compensation plan effectiveness and recommend data-driven enhancements.
Support commission forecasting, accruals, and financial planning activities through collaboration with Finance teams.
Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, and audit standards while supporting internal and external audits.
Develop reporting and analytical insights that help leadership assess compensation program performance and align incentives with business goals.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of experience in compensation, commissions administration, revenue operations, FP&A, sales operations, or a related analytical business function.
Experience administering variable compensation or incentive programs, including commission calculations and payment processes.
Hands-on experience with incentive compensation systems or enterprise commission management platforms.
Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with large datasets.
Experience using business intelligence or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance requirements, and process governance within a business environment.

About Hach & Veralto

Hach is proud to be part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits to build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
Grab Internship Program Overview:
The Grab Internship Program offers students and recent graduates the opportunity to work alongside teams driving Southeast Asia's leading everyday superapp. As an intern, you will not just observe—you will actively contribute to real business challenges, partner with cross-functional teams, and gain hands-on experience in how large-scale, tech-enabled operations run. Throughout the program, you will receive mentorship, project ownership, and exposure to Grab's culture of problem-solving and social impact.
Be a part of an exciting internship from Jan - June 2027. Work placement may vary across Indonesia, ie, Jakarta, Medan, Surabaya, Bali, Semarang, Yogyakarta or where Grab operates.
Get to Know the Role
We are seeking proactive, structured, and curious interns to join our Operations, Project & Process Management talent pool. In this role, you will support teams in optimizing daily operational workflows, driving project milestones, and identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency across business units (e.g., Deliveries, Mobility, Merchant Operations, or Central Operations). You will help transform data and operational observations into structured processes and actionable improvements.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Project Tracking & Execution: Assist project leads in coordinating timelines, tracking deliverables, and monitoring project milestones across cross-functional stakeholders.
Process Review & Mapping: Document current standard operating procedures (SOPs), map end-to-end workflows, and help identify operational bottlenecks or inefficiencies.
Operational Data Support: Collect, clean, and organize operational performance metrics to track baseline SLAs, KPI health, and process turnaround times.
Continuous Improvement Support: Support the rollout of operational enhancement initiatives, pilot programs, or operational tools designed to improve user or partner experiences.
Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate regular check-ins, prepare meeting notes, track action items, and synthesize operational updates into structured decks or summaries.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Minimum GPA of 3.25/4.00
Final-year student or fresh graduate with a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
Strong structured thinking and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail.
Solid written and verbal communication skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
Proficiency in productivity and collaboration tools (Google Workspace: Sheets/Docs/Slides, or MS Excel/PowerPoint).
Familiarity with data analysis tools or visualization platforms (e.g., basic SQL, Tableau, Power BI).
Adaptability and eagerness to learn fast in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Available for a full-time commitment during the internship period.
Additional Information
Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer our Interns:
Comprehensive training and personal development programs: You will develop your soft skills and hard skills curated for you
Mentoring by the Grab Leaders: You will be accompanied by a team of experienced leaders during the internship program
Government Medical benefit: We have you covered with 3 BPJAMSOSTEK programs
Engagement and networking activities: You will participate in fun & interactive engagements that not only entertain but also provide valuable networking opportunities
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our Flex Work arrangements such as differentiated hours
What We Stand For At Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Job Description
We are looking for a Bahasa Indonesia Content Specialist (SMP) who will take ownership of the quality of our learning materials, from developing high-quality content to reviewing fellow teachers' work through structured Quality Control (QC) and peer review. You will craft, audit, and validate SMP-level Bahasa Indonesia materials to ensure accurate answer keys and text analysis, correct language, and pedagogical clarity.
Your primary focus will be SMP-level content (TKA SMP). Occasionally, you may also be asked to provide limited support for SMA/UTBK content, depending on team needs.
Qualifications
Possess at least a Bachelor's Degree in Indonesian Language Education, Indonesian Literature, or a related field.
At least 1 year of experience in creating, teaching, and/or reviewing Bahasa Indonesia content at the SMP level (Kurikulum Merdeka).
Familiar with the TKA SMP framework and question format, or strongly motivated to learn it quickly.
Experience with SMA/UTBK materials is a plus (not required).
Required skills: question item creation, item validation & reliability, classifying question scope/difficulty levels, higher-order thinking skills, content writing, and strong command of KBBI and EYD.
Able to apply Bloom's Taxonomy to design and classify questions by cognitive level (e.g., C1-C6), including HOTS-style questions for TKA SMP.
Hands-on experience reviewing others' work (answer keys, text analysis, and writing) in a structured and detail-oriented way.
High attention to detail, strong time management, and excellent communication skills.
Growth mindset with a desire to continuously learn and adapt to modern edtech trends.
Compensation and Fee Structure
Flexible working hours.

title: Head Of Credit Risk & Data Science
description: Position: Head of Credit Risk & Data Science Department: Credit Risk & Data Science Location: Global About FINN FINN is a fintech company building simple and transparent products that improve financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our core offering gives people access to wages they have already earned, alongside tools that help them manage money better, build savings, access insurance, earn additional income, and use fairer financial services. Founded in 2022, FINN is the largest player in the early wage access space in Southeast Asia and is expanding rapidly into new markets globally. We are looking for ambitious builders who take ownership, move fast, and want to shape products that create meaningful impact in people's lives. About The Role We are looking for a Head of Credit Risk to own and lead FINN's credit risk strategy, underwriting policies, and portfolio performance as we expand across Southeast Asia and other markets. This is a senior risk leadership role focused on balancing sustainable growth, responsible lending, and portfolio profitability. You will own the end-to-end credit risk lifecycle, from risk appetite and underwriting strategy to portfolio monitoring, credit policy optimization, and loss management. You will leverage data science and machine learning to strengthen credit decisioning, improve risk segmentation, and expand access to financial services for underserved customers. You will lead a team of risk analysts and data scientists, ensuring that models and analytical tools translate into effective credit policies and measurable business outcomes. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership, you will establish a scalable, data-driven credit risk function that supports FINN's growth while maintaining strong portfolio quality. Key Responsibilities • Credit Risk Strategy & Portfolio Management • Own FINN's credit risk strategy, risk appetite, underwriting policies, and approval frameworks across products and markets. • Develop and continuously optimize credit policies, risk thresholds, and customer segmentation strategies to balance approval rates, credit losses, and risk-adjusted returns. • Own portfolio performance monitoring, including delinquency, roll rates, default rates, loss rates, and other key credit risk indicators. • Establish early warning systems to identify emerging portfolio risks and implement timely corrective actions. • Lead portfolio reviews, risk assessments, scenario analysis, and stress testing to evaluate portfolio resilience under different economic and business conditions. • Partner with Finance on expected credit loss modeling, provisioning, and portfolio-level financial risk assessments. • Ensure credit risk policies are appropriate for each market and aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and responsible lending standards. • Develop and maintain clear risk governance frameworks, escalation processes, and reporting for executive leadership. • Underwriting & Credit Decisioning • Own the end-to-end underwriting strategy, including customer eligibility, credit assessment, approval rules, and risk-based decisioning. • Improve approval rates and customer conversion while maintaining target default rates and portfolio quality. • Develop and refine risk segmentation strategies to identify underserved customer segments with attractive risk-adjusted returns. • Use portfolio performance data and customer behavior to continuously improve underwriting policies and credit decisions. • Design and evaluate controlled experiments, policy tests, and champion-challenger strategies to measure the impact of underwriting changes. • Partner with Product and Engineering to implement scalable, automated credit decisioning processes that reduce time-to-decision and friction in the customer journey. • Evaluate alternative data sources, credit bureaus, and external partnerships to strengthen risk assessment and improve coverage of underserved populations. • Data Science & ML-Driven Risk Management • Lead the application of data science and machine learning to credit scoring, underwriting, risk segmentation, and fraud detection. • Define model requirements and work with data scientists and engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and continuously improve credit risk models. • Ensure models translate into effective underwriting policies and measurable improvements in approval rates, losses, and risk-adjusted portfolio performance. • Establish appropriate model monitoring, validation, interpretability, fairness, and drift detection practices. • Oversee model experimentation, performance evaluation, and ongoing optimization across products and markets. • Ensure credit decisioning systems are scalable, reliable, and suitable for real-time or near-real-time decisions. • Provide technical direction to the data science team while maintaining sufficient hands-on understanding to challenge assumptions, assess model quality, and guide technical decisions. • Team & Strategic Leadership • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of credit risk professionals, analysts, and data scientists. • Establish clear ownership, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans across the risk and data science functions. • Own the credit risk roadmap and align priorities with business objectives, product development, and market expansion. • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to embed risk considerations into business decisions and customer experiences. • Present portfolio performance, emerging risks, risk strategy, and recommendations to executive leadership and the board. • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, responsible risk-taking, and evidence-based decision-making. Business Impact & Success Measures Success in this role will be measured primarily by the strength and sustainability of FINN's credit portfolio and the effectiveness of its underwriting strategy. Key Outcomes Include • Portfolio quality: Maintain delinquency, default, and credit loss rates within agreed risk appetite. • Risk-adjusted growth: Increase approvals and customer access while preserving sustainable portfolio returns. • Underwriting effectiveness: Improve credit decision accuracy, risk segmentation, and policy performance. • Operational efficiency: Reduce time-to-decision and manual intervention through effective automated underwriting. • Early risk detection: Identify portfolio deterioration promptly and implement effective mitigation strategies. • Model effectiveness: Demonstrate measurable improvements in credit outcomes through ML-driven decisioning and model optimization. • Scalable risk management: Establish consistent risk frameworks that can adapt to new products, markets, and regulatory environments. • Team effectiveness: Build a strong credit risk and data science function with clear accountability and technical capability. Your Profile Required • At least 10 years of relevant experience across credit risk, consumer lending, credit analytics, or data science, with substantial experience leading credit risk strategy and managing consumer credit portfolios. • Proven ownership of credit policies, underwriting frameworks, risk appetite, and portfolio performance within fintech, digital lending, consumer finance, BNPL, digital banking, or a related financial services business. • Demonstrated success balancing approval growth, credit losses, portfolio quality, and risk-adjusted returns. • Experience managing credit risk across multiple products, customer segments, or markets. • Strong understanding of credit risk metrics, portfolio monitoring, delinquency trends, default behavior, loss forecasting, and risk mitigation. • Experience applying credit scoring, statistical modeling, or machine learning to underwriting and credit decisioning. • Sufficient technical depth to evaluate ML-based credit models, challenge model assumptions, and guide data scientists in model development and deployment. • Experience leading and developing teams of credit risk professionals, analysts, and/or data scientists. • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including the ability to interpret model outputs and translate insights into actionable credit policies. • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect credit decisions to customer acquisition, portfolio profitability, and business growth. • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain risk trade-offs clearly. • A proactive, adaptable approach suited to a fast-growing, international startup environment. Bonus • Experience in Southeast Asian credit markets, including familiarity with local credit bureaus, alternative data sources, and lending practices. • Experience in earned wage access, consumer fintech, or lending products serving underbanked customers. • Familiarity with ML model deployment, MLOps, model monitoring frameworks, and experimentation platforms. • Understanding of IFRS 9, expected credit loss modeling, and applicable credit regulations across multiple markets. • Experience launching credit products or establishing risk frameworks in new markets. What We Offer • Competitive compensation based on experience and location. • Equity participation. • The opportunity to build and shape FINN's credit risk function as the business scales. • The opportunity to influence credit strategy, underwriting, and portfolio performance across multiple markets. • The opportunity to work with modern data science and machine learning capabilities. • A mission-driven environment focused on improving financial well-being and expanding responsible access to financial services. Why Join FINN? • Meaningful Impact: Help expand responsible financial access for underbanked employees. • Strategic Ownership: Shape credit risk strategy and portfolio performance at a growing fintech. • Greenfield Opportunity: Build scalable underwriting and risk management capabilities from the ground up. • Technology-Enabled Risk Management: Apply data science and machine learning to improve credit decisions and business outcomes. • Global Growth: Help establish sustainable credit risk frameworks as FINN enters new markets. • Mission-Driven Work: Contribute to fairer, more transparent financial services. #Global

description:
ATech Solution builds and releases minimum viable products (MVPs) quickly. We’re looking for an experienced, hands‐on product marketer to help us decide which ideas deserve further investment. You’ll speak directly with potential customers, run online and offline campaigns, and produce videos that show our products in action. Your findings will help the team decide what to improve, pursue, or stop.

What you’ll do

• Before a launch, identify the customer segment, the problem we think we’re solving, and what we need to learn. Recruit potential users for interviews and demos. Find out how they handle the problem today, how often it occurs, what it costs them, and what would make them switch.
• Choose a meaningful signal for each MVP, such as a pilot commitment, a paid trial, or repeat use. Collect feedback from people who adopt the product and those who walk away. Give the team a concise recommendation on whether to invest further, change the product or audience, or stop development. Be clear about what the evidence supports and what’s still uncertain.
• Define the audience, message, channel, and success measure. Depending on where customers are easiest to reach, you might run a targeted email campaign, arrange a partner demo, or organize a small in‐person product trial. Track what happens after the initial contact.
• Script, storyboard, record, and edit product demos, explainers, and campaign videos. Make the customer’s problem and the product’s value clear. Adapt the footage, pacing, audio, and captions for the audience and channel.
• Review working MVPs for visual consistency, layout, wording, and usability. Work with developers on focused improvements, especially where testing shows that users get confused or abandon a task.
• Keep up with emerging tools and techniques, test them on real projects, and adopt the ones that improve speed or quality. Check AI‐assisted research summaries against the original feedback and verify that generated creative accurately represents the product.

What you’ll bring

• Hands‐on experience marketing early‐stage products, including a project where customer research changed a launch or product decision.
• Practical market research skills, from recruiting participants and conducting interviews to interpreting campaign and product usage data.
• A portfolio of marketing videos you personally helped script, shoot or record, and edit, plus experience delivering campaigns from concept through measurement.
• Strong visual judgment and practical UI/UX skills. You can improve an existing interface and communicate the changes clearly to developers.
• Demonstrated proficiency with current AI tools for creative and design work. You can show where you used them, what you corrected, and how they improved the finished result.
• Fluent spoken English for customer interviews, live demos, and team discussions. The ability to speak Cantonese or Mandarin is a major advantage. You’ll work remotely from Indonesia.

How to apply

Please share your CV, one finished marketing video link, and a brief example of a product or campaign decision you helped make using customer evidence. Tell us what you needed to learn, what people actually said or did, and what you recommended as a result. For the video, identify your contribution and where AI tools were part of your workflow.

Short Form & Ecommerce Video Editor | Remote Work

We’re looking for a creative, reliable video editor who can turn raw footage into engaging stories and product videos that help customers make a purchase. You will edit 20–30 videos per month in total across two brands, Bizkut and a top Singapore Real Estate Agent, covering social media content and ecommerce videos. Bizkut is a Singapore cycling apparel brand founded in 2010, built around making cycling more accessible and inclusive. You’ll work closely with our team to create videos that reflect each brand’s personality, connect with its audience and support sales.

What you’ll do:

Edit short form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, including founder stories, educational content, behind the scenes footage and promotional videos. Create ecommerce videos for product listings, online stores and marketplaces such as Shopify, Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop. Turn product footage into clear, persuasive videos that demonstrate features, explain benefits, show product details and answer common customer questions. Edit product launches, demonstrations and promotional advertisements with suitable calls to action. Build strong openings, clear storylines and effective pacing to capture attention and keep viewers watching. Review raw footage and select the strongest moments, expressions and sound bites. Add accurate subtitles, on-screen text, music, sound effects and supporting visuals. Adjust audio, colour and framing for a polished, consistent result. Adapt videos to different platforms, aspect ratios and placements, keeping important text and product details clearly visible. Follow briefs carefully, apply all revision feedback and check your work before submitting. Organise project files and deliver videos according to the agreed content schedule.

What we’re looking for:

A portfolio demonstrating both short form storytelling and ecommerce product video editing. An understanding of how to edit for different goals, including audience engagement, product education and sales. The ability to communicate product benefits clearly through footage, text and editing. A good understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing and audience retention. The ability to create natural, engaging videos from everyday footage, conversations and walkthroughs. Good English comprehension, with the ability to produce accurate subtitles and clear on-screen copy. Proficiency in editing software such as Insta 360 Studio, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut. Strong attention to detail, especially when following instructions and completing revisions. Good communication, a positive attitude and openness to feedback. The ability to manage deadlines and deliver consistent quality across 20–30 videos per month. Access to a computer capable of handling video editing smoothly and a reliable internet connection for transferring large files.

It’s a bonus if you have:

Experience editing for apparel, lifestyle, sports or personal brands. Experience creating product listing videos, TikTok Shop content or paid social advertisements. Basic motion graphics and sound design skills.

How to apply:

Please submit your CV, expected monthly salary, availability and 3–5 examples of videos you have edited, including at least one ecommerce product video and one storytelling video. Briefly explain your role in creating each example. We’re looking for work that shows you can hold a viewer’s attention while communicating a story or product’s value clearly.

title: Senior Account Executive - Adtech
description:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

Indonesia is the largest market in Southeast Asia and a priority growth market for RZR. We are hiring our first in-market seller in Indonesia to build the book of business, define the ICP, and shape how RZR goes to market across the country.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, INSEA, you will own the full sales cycle with Indonesian app marketers, consumer brands and agencies, working closely with our Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Product teams. You sell a full performance stack — user acquisition, retargeting and CTV — to Indonesia's fastest-growing app companies, with hands-on support from RZR's pre-sales and launch teams.

Key Responsibilities

Own the full sales cycle — from account identification and outreach to contract, launch and handoff — for new RZR customers in Indonesia
Present RZR's UA, retargeting and CTV solutions to decision makers at app-first companies (e-commerce, fintech & digital lending, digital banks, on-demand services, gaming, consumer apps)
Build relationships with Jakarta-based media and performance agencies to win agency-led budgets
Build and maintain a tiered target account list using the INSEA account prioritization framework, and keep pipeline and forecast current in CRM
Partner with Growth and Analytics to scope test plans, agree KPIs and launch new customers successfully
Localize RZR's pitch and case studies for Indonesian clients, working with Marketing on Bahasa Indonesia collateral
Represent RZR at Indonesian and regional industry events
Meet and exceed quarterly new business targets

Required Skills And Experience

5+ years of sales experience in programmatic or mobile advertising in Indonesia, including 3+ years selling performance solutions (UA, retargeting, DSP, ad networks) to app marketers
Professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English — required for this role
A named list of accounts in Indonesia you can bring to RZR, backed by current relationships with growth / UA decision makers and agency performance leads
Track record of closing new logos and meeting or exceeding quota — with numbers to show it
Working knowledge of MMPs and attribution, CPI / CPA / ROAS models, retargeting and Android-first supply
Comfortable working as the only seller in-market, with a regional manager and remote cross-functional support

Nice to have:

Experience selling retargeting or re-engagement solutions
Relationships in e-commerce, fintech and gaming
Experience with CTV or connected-device advertising in Indonesia

The RZR Code

Our Values

Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.

Win with Customers: We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
One Team: No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
Challenge with Respect: We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
Learn Forward: Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

Our Competencies

Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.

Extreme Ownership: Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
Courage: Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
Move Fast: Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
Curiosity: Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
Drive for Excellence: Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
Deliver Results: Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
Proactive Communication: Share information early, before anyone has to ask.
Manage Ambiguity: Make progress when the path isn't clear.

RZR is an equal opportunity employer

RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Senior Forestry Specialist
description:
Are you an experienced forestry auditor who enjoys combining technical certification work with building strong client relationships? Do you want to help forest managers and companies across Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region strengthen responsible forestry practices? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What You Can Expect

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry Specialist based in Indonesia to manage, audit and administer our forestry certification and verification services in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region. Working with internationally recognised standards such as FSC Forest Management, FSC and PEFC Chain of Custody, SBP and Preferred by Nature’s own certification, you will lead audits, review the work of other auditors, manage a client portfolio and drive sales and market development. As one of the faces of Preferred by Nature in the region, you will play a key role in growing our forestry portfolio while keeping the quality of our audits high.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

Conduct forestry certification and verification audits for assigned clients, including on-site visits, remote evaluations and report writing within agreed timeframes and quality requirements.
Act as task manager for your client portfolio, covering client support, audit budgeting, planning and scheduling, and keeping certification and verification records up to date.
Carry out quality reviews of audit reports, including technical review and certification or verification decisions within your qualifications.
Lead sales processes with potential clients, from presentations and scoping to preparing service proposals.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, providing excellent customer service together with the Asia Pacific team.
Support the development of the forestry certification market in Indonesia and across the region.
Ensure efficiency, quality control and adherence to Preferred by Nature’s operational, certification and verification protocols.

Your first year with us:

Within Three Months, You Will

Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature’s forestry certification and verification services, internal systems and procedures.
Get to know your assigned client portfolio in Indonesia and establish working relationships with the Asia Pacific team.
Begin conducting audits and task management for assigned clients, and start the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

Independently lead audits and manage your client portfolio, from planning and budgeting through to reporting.
Prepare service proposals and take part in client presentations and sales meetings with potential clients.
Progress towards quality reviewer qualifications for the key standards in your portfolio.

Within twelve months, you will:

Hold qualifications as auditor, quality reviewer and task manager for your assigned forestry schemes.
Manage a stable and growing client portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.
Contribute actively to market development, identifying and following up on new business opportunities in Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region.

Important that you:

Hold a bachelor’s degree in forestry, natural resource management, environmental science or a related field.
Bring at least four years of relevant experience in the forestry industry, a certification body, an NGO or another international organisation.
Are qualified as an auditor under FSC Forest Management, FSC Chain of Custody, PEFC Chain of Custody and/or SBP.
Are fluent in written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia.
Have good communication and client management skills, and feel confident presenting to clients and preparing proposals.
Possess strong analytical and report-writing skills.
Have strong self-management skills, with the ability to stay focused and follow through on commitments.
Are comfortable travelling within Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region for on-site audits.
Are proficient in MS Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

Have experience as a quality reviewer or task manager in a certification body.
Bring experience in sales or business development within a certification or consulting environment.
Have worked in an international, multicultural team.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart

Global work culture
High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.
An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.
Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development
Potential future international travel opportunities
A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment
20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. With 350+ employees and a network of local experts, we develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains in 100+ countries. We focus on forest and climate impact commodities and related sectors.

How To Apply

If you feel you meet the requirements of the role, please submit your application, including salary expectations, via the application form below.

Application pre-screening will be conducted during the application period. Preferred by Nature wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Financial Planner | Professional Career Growth | Full-Time & Part-Time Opportunities

Before You Apply

Rencana Bijak Academy is a professional development program by PT Rencana Bijak Indonesia, a professional financial consulting company built on the Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) standard. The program opens a career path toward becoming a Certified Financial Planner (CFP®), including an individual insurance agency practice with our partner insurance companies, licensed by AAJI and/or AASI and registered with the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) under the applicable agency structure.

This is a performance-based business opportunity, not a salaried employment role. In return, you get greater flexibility to manage your schedule, work from anywhere, and build a long-term Financial Planning business with uncapped income potential.

You may pursue this opportunity either by building a full-time practice through our Career Switch Program (CSP) or alongside your current profession through our Dual Career Program (DCP).

About the Opportunity

At Rencana Bijak, we are committed to helping individuals and families build stronger financial foundations, planning before products, education before decisions.

As a Financial Planner and a business partner of related insurance companies, your primary focus is to educate clients, understand their financial goals, develop personalized financial plans, and help them implement those plans through appropriate financial solutions, including insurance products from our partner insurance companies when relevant.

What You'll Do

Improve financial literacy through education and consultation.
Understand clients' financial goals and priorities.
Develop personalized Financial Plans.
Recommend appropriate financial solutions, including insurance products from our partner insurance companies when relevant.
Build long-term client relationships based on trust and professional advice.
Continuously develop your expertise as a Financial Planning professional.

Choose Your Career Path

Both paths go through the same structured onboarding: Rencana Bijak Academy OVT + 16 mentoring sessions, mentorship, and business development.

Career Switch Program (CSP): build your Financial Planning practice full-time, with an intensive onboarding pace.
Dual Career Program (DCP): start your practice alongside your current profession, with a flexible schedule.

What You'll Gain

A proven system to build your own Financial Planning business as a business partner of related insurance companies.
Certification pathway AWP → RFP → CFP®, with scholarship opportunities for eligible participants.
Access to the Rencana Bijak fee-based consulting ecosystem for certified CFPs (our Choice of Client model, where clients opt for fee-based consultations).
One-on-one mentorship, practical business coaching, and a supportive professional network.
Flexible working arrangements with control over your time and location.

Already a CFP®? This Unlocks for You

• Paid 1-on-1 consultations: Deliver fee-based financial consultations through the Rencana Bijak platform (your clients, your schedule, paid per session).

• Paid B2B teaching: Serve as an instructor in our corporate financial literacy training programs, with honorarium per program.

• Webinar speaking (pro bono): Speak at Rencana Bijak educational webinars, an education contribution that helps you earn your CPD (Continuing Professional Development) points under FPSB.

• Certification fee compensation: CFPs who complete the program requirements receive reimbursement of previously incurred CFP® certification costs, per our scholarship policy.

Who We're Looking For

Indonesian citizen, eligible for AAJI/AASI licensing.
Bachelor's degree.
Passionate about personal finance or wealth management.
Enjoy helping others make better financial decisions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Committed to continuous learning and professional growth.
Value entrepreneurship and long-term relationship building.
Previous experience in sales or customer service is an advantage but not required.

If you want to become a business partner of related insurance companies, build a meaningful profession, grow a long-term Financial Planning business, and make a positive impact on the financial well-being of individuals and families, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

We're looking for an accountant who wants to run accounting on an AI-native platform, not just use one. You'll operate our clients' books on InterOpera's platform: reviewing and approving what our AI agents prepare, closing the month and delivering financial statements. You'll also be the accountant's voice inside our product team.

On the project, you'll work with our product and engineering team to turn accounting rules into system logic for our clients. You'll also work directly with clients to understand their requirements, and may take on project management where needed.

This role suits someone who has a solid accounting foundation, enjoys working with technology, is comfortable working with clients, and We're looking for an accountant who wants to run accounting on an AI-native platform, not just use one. You'll operate our clients' books on InterOpera's platform: reviewing and approving what our AI agents prepare, closing the month and delivering financial statements. You'll also be the accountant's voice inside our product team.

Key Responsibilities

Client Accounting Operations on Our Platform

Run the monthly accounting cycle for assigned client entities on our platform: document intake, AI-prepared journal entries, bank reconciliations, trial balance and financial statements.

Review the AI agents' work in the review queue: approve, correct or reject entries, mappings and matches, and record why.

Close each client's month on the agreed timeline and sign off the figures before they reach the client.

Resolve the exceptions the AI cannot resolve (unmatched bank lines, unknown counterparties, missing documents) and request missing items from clients.

Keep a clear audit trail: every figure traceable to its source document, and every rule change approved by someone other than its author.

Product Feedback & Rulebook

Use the platform every day as its most demanding user, and report what slows you down, what the AI gets wrong and what's missing.

Feed your corrections back as rules and examples so the AI gets the same case right next time.

Join product reviews with engineering: challenge designs from the accountant's side and propose changes to workflows, screens and reports.

Track AI accuracy for your clients (e.g. share of entries approved without correction, recurring error types) and report the trends.

Administration

Maintain and organise corporate records, contracts, agreements and company documents digitally.

Help prepare board and shareholder resolutions, meeting minutes and other corporate secretarial documents.

Support statutory and regulatory compliance (e.g. ACRA filings).

Handle HR administration: onboarding and offboarding, employee records, leave tracking and employment contracts.

Support monthly payroll preparation and related documents, including payslips.

Coordinate with external parties, including the corporate secretary, auditors, tax consultants, banks and vendors.

Manage vendor administration, subscriptions and procurement documents.

Handle general office administration and ad-hoc requests from management.

Finance

Assist in processing vendor and supplier payments, and prepare payment documents for approval.

Support accounts payable and receivable, including invoicing, collections follow-up and aging reports.

Check and process employee expense claims and reimbursements.

Help prepare budgets, forecasts and budget-vs-actual analysis.

Help prepare financial data and reports for management.

Support tax administration, including documents and supporting data for tax filings (e.g. corporate income tax with IRAS).

Accounting

Assist in recording daily transactions and journal entries in the accounting system.

Help prepare month-end adjustments (accruals, prepayments, amortisation, depreciation).

Assist with bank, intercompany, vendor and customer reconciliations.

Support month-end and year-end closing, including the trial balance and supporting schedules.

Help maintain the fixed asset and intangible asset registers.

Assist in preparing financial statements.

Help prepare audit schedules and supporting documents for the annual audit.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

3-5 years of experience in accounting, finance or administration.

Solid understanding of accounting principles (double-entry, accruals, revenue recognition) and IFRS.

Has been the accountable reviewer of someone else's work (e.g. as a senior, auditor or fund accountant).

Writes clearly: explains an accounting treatment and a software bug equally well.

Handles confidential client financial data with care.

Hands-on experience with accounting systems (Xero, NetSuite, Accurate or similar).

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (e.g. lookups, pivot tables).

Tech-savvy: learns new software quickly and is comfortable with cloud-based tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Notion, Slack).

Uses AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to work more efficiently, and is interested in automating manual processes.

Logical, structured thinker who can explain accounting treatment step by step, to both engineers and clients.

Highly detail-oriented, with strong documentation habits.

Confident communicating with clients in English, both spoken and written.

Able to work independently and manage several priorities in a fast-paced startup.

Has given structured feedback to a software vendor or worked closely with a product team.

Experience managing project timelines and tasks.

Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA, CA, CPA), completed or in progress.

Experience implementing an accounting system or ERP, or working at a SaaS / tech company.

What Success Looks Like

Months 2–3:

Own month-end close for 2–3 client entities, each signed off within 7 business days of month-end.

A collaborative, flexible, fully digital work environment.

Gain hands-on exposure across finance, administration, HR, and systems management in a fast-scaling environment.

Be part of an AI-driven startup, where you’ll learn how emerging technologies are applied to real-world business operations.

Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan, pain points, kondisi aset, serta kebutuhan inspeksi calon klien.

Menjelaskan layanan, scope pekerjaan, value proposition, dan solusi inspeksi yang relevan.

Menindaklanjuti leads dan opportunities secara sistematis hingga tahap proposal, negosiasi, dan closing.

Mengelola proses sales secara end-to-end, mulai dari prospecting hingga kontrak atau purchase order.

3. Proposal, Quotation & Negotiation

Menyusun quotation, proposal bisnis, scope of work, dan penawaran komersial sesuai kebutuhan calon klien.

Berkoordinasi dengan tim teknis dan operasional untuk memastikan feasibility, scope, timeline, dan deliverables.

Melakukan negosiasi harga, terms of payment, scope pekerjaan, serta commercial terms.

Mengelola dokumen kerja sama seperti kontrak, MoU, vendor registration, purchase order, dan dokumen administrasi terkait.

4. Account Management & Partnership

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan existing clients.

Mengembangkan repeat business, upselling, cross-selling, serta peluang inspeksi berkala.

Mengidentifikasi peluang kontrak jangka panjang dan recurring inspection.

Mengembangkan partnership dengan property management, facility management, property consultants, contractors, developers, dan perusahaan terkait.

5. Sales Pipeline & Reporting

Mengelola sales pipeline, CRM, database leads, serta seluruh aktivitas follow-up.

Menyusun laporan aktivitas, sales performance, forecast, dan pipeline secara berkala.

Melakukan analisis terhadap conversion rate, sales cycle, win-loss, serta efektivitas channel prospecting.

Mencapai target lead generation, meeting, quotation, revenue, dan closing yang ditetapkan perusahaan.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum S1 dari jurusan Business, Marketing, Management, Engineering, Property Management, atau bidang relevan lainnya.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2–4 tahun di bidang B2B Sales, Business Development, Corporate Sales, atau Account Management.

Memiliki pengalaman melakukan outbound sales, prospecting, cold outreach, dan membuka new business opportunities.

Terbiasa berkomunikasi dan melakukan presentasi kepada corporate clients maupun decision makers.

Memiliki kemampuan menyusun proposal, quotation, presentasi, dan dokumen penawaran bisnis.

Memiliki kemampuan negosiasi, komunikasi, networking, dan relationship management yang baik.

Terbiasa menggunakan CRM, Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, LinkedIn, dan tools penjualan lainnya.

Memiliki kemampuan mengelola sales pipeline dan melakukan follow-up secara terstruktur.

Proaktif, persisten, mandiri, target-oriented, serta nyaman bekerja dengan target penjualan.

Memiliki kemampuan analitis untuk memahami kebutuhan klien dan mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis.

Bersedia melakukan business meeting, client visits, dan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Memiliki network atau pengalaman menjual kepada perusahaan di sektor property, construction, manufacturing, facility management, hospitality, commercial real estate, atau industrial sector.

Memiliki pengalaman menjual jasa B2B dengan proses sales cycle yang relatif panjang.

Pernah menangani corporate procurement, vendor registration, tender, RFP, atau project-based sales.

Memahami dasar-dasar building maintenance, property management, construction, atau building engineering menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki pengalaman mengembangkan akun corporate dan recurring business.

Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris bisnis yang baik.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote
